content_generation.blog_excerpt: The 1992 Tamil film 'Singaravelan' stands as a testament to the magical collaboration between actor Kamal Haasan and music maestro Ilaiyaraaja. More than just a romantic comedy, the film's enduring legacy is deeply intertwined with its chart-topping soundtrack. Ilaiyaraaja, at the zenith of his career, crafted a collection of songs that perfectly captured the film's lighthearted spirit while also delivering profound melodic beauty. Tracks like 'Chinnaponnu' and 'Kaathal Vaibogame' became instant classics, showcasing the vocal prowess of S.P. Balasubrahmanyam and S. Janaki. This vinyl pressing, despite its age, offers a tangible connection to an era when film music was the heartbeat of Tamil culture, making it a prized possession for any archivist or collector.
